tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Browse the catalog, newest first or by popularity, optionally filtered by category.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Full-text search over product names, descriptions and tags. Ordered by upvotes.

tools.name: submit_product
tools.description: List a product, tool or website in the AI Startup Hub directory. Returns the slug and the URL of a server-rendered, indexable page that carries a dofollow backlink to the submitted url. The url must be publicly reachable. No API key needed; limit 10 submissions per hour per IP, 3 products per host.

tools.name: upvote_product
tools.description: Upvote a product. One vote per IP per product.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: submit_product · Private data: submit_product · Public sink: submit_product.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: submit_product · Private data: submit_product · Public sink: submit_product

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
